item.title: 3 killed, 2 injured in motorcycle-scooter collision in Odisha’s Keonjhar
item.description: Bhubaneswar: Three persons were killed and two others were critically injured after a motorcycle collided with a scooter in Odisha’s Keonjhar district today. The deceased were identified as Dushasana Barik (40) of Asanabahali village and Laxman Senapati (25) and Manoj Kumar Dalei of Balabhadrapur. The motorcycle collided head-on with the scooter on Chandapasi-Pandapada road near Sarupata at around 6.30 pm, killing the trio on the spot. item.title: CBI plans to question TVK leader Vijay in Karur stampede case
item.description: Chennai: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is preparing to question Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) chief Vijay in connection with the tragic stampede in Tamil Nadu's Karur that claimed 41 lives, sources said. item.description: Digapahandi/Berhampur: What began as an ordinary morning ended up in heartbreaking tragedy for a family after a minor boy collapsed and died before he could reach school today in Odisha's Ganjam district. item.title: PM Modi, MPs pay tributes to security personnel killed in 2001 Parliament terror attack
item.description: New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with several other parliamentarians, paid homage on Saturday to the security personnel who were martyred in the 2001 terror attack on Parliament. On December 13, 2001, five terrorists belonging to the Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) targeted the Parliament complex, leading to the deaths of six Delhi Police personnel, two members of the Parliament Security Service, and a gardener.
